entities.name: CloudFormation
entities.rationale: Visible on the whiteboard to the left of the EC2 group with the CloudFormation icon and label.

entities.name: S3
entities.rationale: Visible on the whiteboard beneath CloudFormation, storing master files.

entities.name: ASG
entities.rationale: Visible above the dashed container holding the EC2 instances, labeled ASG.

entities.name: EC2 Top
entities.rationale: The top EC2 instance running ORT playout within the dashed AZ container, labeled with '10'.

entities.name: EC2 Middle
entities.rationale: The middle EC2 instance running ORT playout within the dashed AZ container, labeled with '10'.

entities.name: EC2 Bottom
entities.rationale: The bottom EC2 instance running ORT playout within the dashed AZ container, labeled with '10'.

entities.name: Direct Connect
entities.rationale: Visible on the right side of the EC2 instances, providing dedicated connectivity back to on-premise locations.

entities.name: NYC
entities.rationale: Drawn as a satellite dish at the top right labeled NYC representing the BCP uplink.

entities.name: ATL
entities.rationale: Drawn as a satellite dish below NYC labeled ATL representing the Atlanta distribution uplink.

entities.name: TWD / CNN CENTER
entities.rationale: Drawn as an on-premises building at the bottom right labeled TWD/CNN CENTER.
